_note: EA, FI, JNPR, CFLT, IPG, FYBR and USM were requested and are absent from the SEC company_tickers.json file on the retrieval date, so they carry no payload here. They are left out on purpose: the taxonomy tests use them as the tickers that cannot resolve. FI is the subtlest of them, because Fiserv is very much still listed and the SEC file simply still carries it under its pre-2023 symbol FISV.
_pruning: Each payload is reduced to cik, name, sic, sicDescription and the filing rows the point-in-time admission test reads. From filings.recent only four rows survive: the earliest submission in the window, the earliest 10-K, the earliest 10-Q and the most recent submission, each with its form, which is everything the earliest-periodic-report rule needs and nothing else. filings.files keeps each older shard's filingFrom and filingTo, which is where a long-lived filer's history before the recent window lives.
